$comment: Generated by tools/token-contexts.mjs: aliases that read a token the contrast modifier overrides, declared again in each contrast context so they follow a subtree's context. Never edit by hand.

dot-colour.$description: A point at rest (echoed for contrast contexts)

name-selected.$description: A frame's name while the frame is selected (the same as at rest by default; a theme may tint it) (echoed for contrast contexts)

key-outline.$description: Outline colour of a key name (control strength, 3:1) (echoed for contrast contexts)

border.$description: The swatch's edge, at control strength (3:1) (echoed for contrast contexts)

head-fg.$description: Text of the header row’s label cell (echoed for contrast contexts)

outline.$description: Colour of the enclosure and the row hairlines (drawn per cell, in each cell’s context) (echoed for contrast contexts)

divider.$description: Colour of the hairline between rows (echoed for contrast contexts)

head-fg.$description: Text of the header row (echoed for contrast contexts)

outline.$description: Colour of the enclosure (echoed for contrast contexts)

divider.$description: The divider's colour, when a theme draws one (echoed for contrast contexts)

outline.$description: Colour of the preview’s enclosure (echoed for contrast contexts)

readonly-border.$description: A read-only box: a quieter outline than an editable one (3:1 not required: it takes no input), on the page surface with no fill (echoed for contrast contexts)

muted.$description: MP20, ID41: the role class muted, secondary lines and shapes (3:1 or more on the surface) (echoed for contrast contexts)

tile-fill.$description: A tile's surface inside its hairline outline: a control's (default); a theme that draws tiles outlined on the page sets the page's own background (echoed for contrast contexts)

border.$description: The button's outline: the soft control outline its fill already marks, text strength in more contrast (Q71) (echoed for contrast contexts)

title-color-s.$description: size s: a group's title in the muted text colour; the space above it and its place tell the groups apart (echoed for contrast contexts)

border.$description: The popup edge over the page (echoed for contrast contexts)

bar-track.$description: The bar's unfilled track; stronger under more contrast (echoed for contrast contexts)

divider.$description: The hairline's colour, when a theme draws one (echoed for contrast contexts)
The one hairline above each row (echoed for contrast contexts)

colour.$description: The thumb at rest: 3:1 on the canvas and the raised and sunken surfaces in every context (echoed for contrast contexts)

colour-active.$description: The thumb while hovered or dragged (echoed for contrast contexts)

current-rule.$description: IP32: the full rule around the current place at current="rule" (3:1 against the page); never a one-sided stripe (echoed for contrast contexts)

fill.$description: A placeholder's shape: the standard border colour, visible on the canvas, raised and sunken surfaces; stronger under more contrast (echoed for contrast contexts)

fg.$description: Neutral status (no judgement: draft, inactive): text and icons; follows muted text, so more contrast raises it (echoed for contrast contexts)
